title: Animated Modal
description: Native dialog whose panel springs in with a tilt over a blurred backdrop.

a11y.motion: The spring, scale and tilt are dropped; the panel and backdrop fade in and out over 150–200ms.
a11y.keyboard: The trigger is a native button. Opening moves focus into the dialog and Tab stays inside it (native showModal); Escape, the × button and ModalClose close it, and focus returns to the element that opened it.
a11y.screenReader: A native modal <dialog> named by its title (or aria-labelledby) and described by its description; the page behind is inert while it is open.

examples.name: book-trip
examples.title: Book your trip
examples.description: A travel booking modal with a photo strip, trip details and a CTA footer.
